title: ReelClip controls: split a recording into equal clips
summary: In Cut, choose No gap, set Clip amount, check the calculated Clip duration, then Add the plan and preview its consecutive sections.

video.scope: Existing native app recording with a few frames held for readability. It demonstrates planning and previewing three equal sections, without a completed save to Photos.

context: The recording starts with a video already imported and Cut selected; importing is not demonstrated.
This example uses the whole 4m14.2s source. Coverage is limited to the selected source window when a shorter window is chosen.
Control meanings were cross-checked against the app catalog and the visible states in this recording. The app version and its match to the current source build are not established.

controls.label: Cut
controls.location: Editing mode selector, above Cut recipe
controls.meaning: Choose a recipe using clip count, clip length and source spacing.
controls.observed: Cut is already selected when the walkthrough starts.

controls.label: Space / No gap
controls.location: Space row in Cut recipe; hold its shuffle button
controls.meaning: Space controls source time skipped between planned clips. Holding this row's shuffle button chooses No gap and turns off random spacing.
controls.observed: Space changes from 10s to No gap. The recipe displays: No gaps · the whole video is fully covered.

controls.label: Clip amount
controls.location: Minus and plus controls at the top of Cut recipe
controls.meaning: Set the requested number of clips. With No gap and count-based sizing, changing this count recalculates the equal clip duration for the selected source.
controls.observed: The minus control changes four clips to three. The rounded Clip duration changes from 1m04s to 1m25s.

controls.label: Clip duration
controls.meaning: Clip length is separate from skipped source spacing. In this count-based No gap example, check the calculated duration after setting the count.
controls.observed: The large label reads 1m25s. The more precise readout is 4m14.2s ÷ 3 = 1m24.7s each.

controls.label: Add
controls.location: Cut recipe action, after checking the recipe values
controls.meaning: Add the current Cut recipe to Planned Clips for review. This action does not save the clips to Photos or publish them.
controls.observed: Three consecutive ranges appear in Planned Clips and the bottom action becomes Review 3 clips.

steps.title: Choose No gap
steps.instruction: Start in Cut with the full source selected. Hold the Space shuffle button until No gap appears. Check the whole-video coverage message.

steps.title: Set the clip count and check duration
steps.instruction: Use Clip amount to choose three clips. Check No gap remains selected and read the calculated 1m24.7s duration; the main label rounds this to 1m25s.

steps.title: Add and check the planned ranges
steps.instruction: Tap Add. Check that all three ranges meet end to start and cover 0:00–4:14.2 in Planned Clips.

steps.title: Preview the three planned clips
steps.instruction: Open the review and play each planned section. The walkthrough shows actual previews of all three; it ends before any completed Photos save.

example.rounding_note: The visible duration and range labels are rounded. Use the actual planned ranges, rather than assuming every displayed value is exact to a frame.

screenshots.description: Cut recipe: Clip amount 3, Clip duration 1m25s, precise 1m24.7s readout and Space No gap. Review 0 clips is still disabled before Add.
Planned Clips: three consecutive source ranges, with Review 3 clips available after Add.

limits: Space skips source time; it does not insert black frames or a blank pause into the output.
Add creates a plan. Previewing that plan does not establish a successful save to Photos.
The recording does not show importing, purchasing, a completed export or posting to a social platform.
This is an English-control reference for this recording. Translated guide instructions and captions do not change the language of the app pixels.
The example demonstrates equal sections, not a prediction of social reach or an automatic choice of the best moments.
